### Consideration: Scoping the fix to avoid unintended side effects on other reasoning models

First commit auto-enables `interleaved: { field: "reasoning_content" }` for all models with `capabilities.reasoning: true`, and the fallback injects `reasoning_content: ""` into `providerOptions` for all assistant messages when reasoning is active.

This is likely harmless for non-DeepSeek models because:

1. Provider-specific SDKs only read fields they recognize — unknown fields are ignored
2. `reasoning_content` is not a field used by the Anthropic, OpenAI, or Gemini SDKs
3. An empty string value is a no-op even if read

However, if you want to be conservative and scope the fix to only providers that actually need this pattern, the fallback could be gated more narrowly:

```typescript
// Instead of:
if (model.capabilities.reasoning) {

// Consider:
if (model.capabilities.reasoning && (
  model.api.id.includes("deepseek") || 
  model.id.includes("deepseek") ||
  model.api.npm === "@ai-sdk/openai-compatible" ||
  model.api.npm === "@openrouter/ai-sdk-provider"
)) {
```

This ensures the `reasoning_content` injection only fires for:

- Direct DeepSeek API calls
- OpenRouter-routed DeepSeek models  
- Any `openai-compatible` provider (since that's where the `reasoning_content` field pattern originates)

It would leave other reasoning models (Claude thinking, o-series, Gemini) unaffected and avoid unnecessary providerOptions writes.

Happy to push this as an additional commit if you prefer the narrower scope. Leaving it as-is is also fine if you're confident the extra fields are truly no-op for other providers.

OpenCode model-switch bug investigation:
- Confirmed the bug you described — it matches issues #23666 and #23741 on the opencode GitHub
- Root cause identified by contributor kagera-agent: the createEffect in local.tsx that syncs agent model fires on every reactive refresh (after message completion), overwriting the user's manual selection
- Related issues: #21351 (Plan/Build switch resets model), #23369 (session resume loses model), #6636 (subagent model bleeds into main agent)
- All appear to share one root cause: per-agent selectedModel state not persisting correctly across mode switches, message completions, and session resume

> * The user said: "Continue if you have next steps, or stop and ask for clarification if you are unsure how to proceed."

I encountered this issue as well. The message quoted above is generated by the OpenCode harness and **_not_** by "the user". The harness pretends to be the user and sends this message after an auto compaction, which also ends up as a user message in the history. I can't find the exact location in the src but #13946 mentioned this logic (though the current version doesn't have it there). This practice (i.e., role misassignment) is quite dangerous because it confuses the model and makes the model think the user has grant consent. 

I think this behavior may also contribute to [#15533](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/issues/15533), but the current PR at [#15532](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/15532) will likely not fix it. Based on the description, it seems to only gate the synthetic continue message based on finish reason, but still injects a synthetic `role=user` message when the assistant was in tool-call/unknown state, so the underlying issue remains.

I'm not sure `rule.md` can fix this or cover edge situations because the model cannot distinguish synthetic vs real user messages, and "continue" is such an open-ended and model-dependent instructions.

This impersonation is a serious design flaw in agent control. Please fix it.
